title: Split Capacity
statement_md: Load a line of crates onto $k$ carts. Each cart takes a **contiguous** run of crates. Make the heaviest cart as light as possible.
input_md: The first line holds $n$ and $k$. The second line holds $n$ crate weights.
output_md: Print the minimum possible weight of the heaviest cart.
hints: Pattern: binary search on the answer.
For a capacity C, a greedy pass tells you how many carts you need. More capacity never needs more carts.
